name: Thomas Gebhart
headline: Professional Services and Customer Care Executive | Vertical SaaS and Enterprise Software | GTM & Post-Sales Strategy | Operational Excellence | Enterprise Transformation and Scale
position: Vice President of Professional Services, Front Office and Residential Solutions
about:
I am a Professional Services executive with 20+ years of experience leading customer-facing teams in high-growth SaaS companies, helping organizations scale and transform. I specialize in uniting Professional Services, Customer Care, Support, Education, and Customer Success under cohesive strategies that drive adoption and long-term customer value.

My background spans both vertical SaaS and platform environments, giving me a unique playbook for managing the depth and breadth of customer experiences. I bring a pragmatic, data-informed, and empathetic leadership style to complex transformations—whether integrating acquisitions, navigating market disruptions, or scaling global delivery models. I pride myself on cross-functional collaboration, aligning go-to-market teams to deliver outcome-focused results.

As a leader, I empower teams to operate at their next level. I believe in fostering learning-centered, accountable cultures where leaders are supported and stretched toward shared goals. While I’ve held broad responsibilities, I remain close to the work—eager to roll up my sleeves and engage with the technology and customer journey.

I’m grateful for the opportunity to contribute to these companies, to have been mentored by exceptional leaders, and to see the lasting impact of my work.

Highlights
- Led global, cross-functional teams of 20 to 200+
- Directed diverse portfolios of 2,000+ projects
- Held full P&L responsibility with aggressive top- and bottom-line targets
- Deep experience with Enterprise Software across both PE-backed and public companies
- Orchestrated 6+ M&A integrations with a focus on continuity and client satisfaction
- Led partner programs to drive ecosystem development and scale delivery capacity
- Established PS sales organization to improve scoping and expectation alignment
… more

experiences.position: Vice President of Professional Services, Front Office and Residential Solutions

• Improved CSAT scores, reduced response times, and cut call wait times
• Led recurring TAM program aligned with customer success and renewal goals

Oversaw Project Management, Consulting, Technical Services, Education Services, and Services Sales. Accountable for practice operations, financial performance, and leadership development, while driving software adoption and cross-functional growth in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.

• Delivered $85M in new ARR through successful customer go-lives

experiences.position: Senior Director and Vertical Lead, Professional Services
experiences.description:
Led a 100-person team generating $15M in annual PS revenue, as part of a $150M global practice.  Over my 12 years at NetSuite, we grew from $17M to over $1B in revenue, I was able to take on progressively senior roles within the Professional Services organization. I led the Professional Services team focused on the Wholesale Distribution vertical—NetSuite’s largest industry segment. I focused on customer implementation success, scaling delivery operations, building high-performing teams, and developing go-to-market strategies that aligned with product and sales.

Key Accomplishments:
- Scaled vertical revenue from $2.3M in 2011 to $15M in 2016
- Directed a portfolio of 170+ concurrent customer implementations, overseeing over 100,000 hours of service delivery
- Built and led five delivery teams across three products: NetSuite ERP, NetSuite WMS, and OrderMotion
- Launched and scaled a PS sales function focused on accelerating services growth in the Wholesale Distribution vertical
- Collaborated cross-functionally to develop and execute GTM strategy for NetSuite’s largest vertical

Led a 15+ person implementation team, managing a portfolio of up to 100 concurrent projects in the emerging and mid-market segments. Responsible for hiring, developing, and mentoring consultants and project managers while driving operational excellence and delivering strong customer outcomes.

Highlights:
- Quota carrying role for achieving Professional Services revenue targets
- Responsible for PS sales and SOW's for practice delivery
- Shaped the go-to-market strategy for the Products and Wholesale Distribution vertical
- Optimized resource utilization, staffing, and customer satisfaction

Responsible for the successful deployment of the NetSuite platform to the SMB segment using a shared resource delivery model.

Highlights:
- Oversaw all aspects of project delivery, including configuration, testing, data migration, and training
- Managed 10–20 concurrent implementation projects

- Managed Customer Success for 30+ insurance carriers participating within InsWeb’s online lead aggregation and marketing platform
- Led multiple initiatives driving B2B2C maturity and outcomes with consumers and insurance carriers
- Managed internal teams responsible for developing customized CRM system for internal contact center (Sales, Account Management, Support)
- Developed internal consulting practice, methodology, and tools focused on customer success and platform expansion efforts with data and process analysis
